items.title: Git Worktree Isolation
items.description:
## Summary
Isolate each agent in its own git worktree and branch so concurrent work cannot overwrite shared files.

## Roadmap Slot
Q2 2026

## Current State in Repo
Crux currently coordinates agents in one project directory via tmux sessions. The phase system checks dependency/file overlap, but physical filesystem isolation per agent is not implemented yet.

## Target Outcome
Each agent runs in an orchestrator-managed worktree with explicit branch lifecycle, merge policy, and cleanup.

## Scope

items.title: Cost and Token Telemetry
items.description:
## Summary
Track and expose token and cost usage by agent, prompt, phase, and session.

## Roadmap Slot
Q2 2026

## Current State in Repo
Status and memory features exist, but there is no first-class cost/token accounting surfaced in CLI or TUI.

## Target Outcome
Operators can inspect live and cumulative usage with provider-aware cost estimates.

## Scope
- Capture prompt/completion token counts and model/provider metadata per interaction.
- Compute per-agent, per-phase, and per-session rollups

items.title: Session Replay
items.description:
## Summary
Provide deterministic playback of orchestration sessions for debugging and auditability.

## Roadmap Slot
Q2 2026

## Current State in Repo
A replay command and event log concepts are present in the repo, but full-fidelity timeline playback of all orchestrator and gate decisions is not complete.

## Target Outcome
`crux replay <session-id>` can reconstruct and step through a complete session timeline.

## Scope
- Finalize event schema for assignments, agent messages, gate runs, decisi

items.title: Checkpoint and Resume
items.description:
## Summary
Persist full orchestrator runtime state and resume safely after interruption.

## Roadmap Slot
Q2 2026

## Current State in Repo
Session context persistence exists in `internal/memory/session`, but full crash-safe resume for world state, in-flight progress, and phase cursor is not a completed end-to-end workflow.

## Target Outcome
`crux resume` restores session continuity with no manual reconstruction.

## Scope
- Define checkpoint payload covering world state, phase position, agent

items.title: OpenTelemetry Integration
items.description:
## Summary
Emit OTLP-compatible traces and spans for orchestration lifecycle events.

## Roadmap Slot
Ongoing / Cross-Cutting

## Current State in Repo
Observability currently relies on local logs, session artifacts, and project-specific tooling; native OTLP export is not present.

## Target Outcome
Teams can stream Crux telemetry into standard observability backends.

## Scope
- Instrument orchestrator loop, gate execution, assignment, and messaging boundaries.
- Add configurable OTLP exporter

items.title: Issue to Phase Auto-Decomposition
items.description:

Automatically turn qualifying GitHub issues into phase specs and prompt docs, then prepare an approval PR.

## Roadmap Slot
Q3 2026

## Current State in Repo
Phase authoring exists (`crux phase create`) but is manually initiated and not tied to issue label automation.

## Target Outcome
A labeled issue can trigger generation of phase artifacts and a reviewable PR without manual decomposition.

## Scope

items.title: Webhook and Event-Driven Triggers
items.description:
## Summary
Add watch mode to launch or update sessions based on GitHub webhook events.

## Roadmap Slot
Q3 2026

## Current State in Repo
Repo already has GitHub Actions automation for roadmap sync, but Crux itself does not run as an event-driven orchestration service.

## Target Outcome
`crux watch` can react to configured webhook events and dispatch workflows safely.

## Scope
- Implement event intake and signature validation for supported webhook types.
- Map events to watch rules and orchest

items.title: Parallel Phase Execution via Dependency Graph
items.description:

Execute independent phases concurrently using dependency and file-overlap constraints.

## Roadmap Slot
Q3 2026

## Current State in Repo
Phase dependencies and disjoint file validation are modeled, but runtime scheduling is still effectively sequential.

## Target Outcome
Scheduler can run multiple ready phases in parallel without violating dependency safety.

## Scope
- Build readiness evaluator from dependency graph and gate states.

Crux tracks decisions and phase progression, but no standardized KPI layer exists for per-agent quality and efficiency.

items.title: Language Expansion Preset Packs
items.description:

Add first-class preference and role presets for TypeScript, Python, and Rust workflows.

## Roadmap Slot
Ongoing / Cross-Cutting

## Current State in Repo
Current role and preference defaults are strongest for Go-centric development patterns.

## Target Outcome
Users can select language-specific conventions, testing, and linting presets by default.

## Scope
- Define preset packs for TypeScript, Python, and Rust coding/testing conventions.

items.title: Codebase Context Engine
items.description:
## Summary
Generate dynamic, relevance-ranked code context before task assignment.

## Roadmap Slot
Q4 2026

## Current State in Repo
Phase prompts currently rely on static required reading and manual context curation.

## Target Outcome
Assignments automatically include high-signal files and metadata based on task intent.

## Scope
- Index call/dependency relationships and recency/ownership signals.
- Rank files and snippets per assignment request.
- Inject bounded context package into agent pr

items.title: Multi-Repo and Monorepo Support
items.description:
## Summary
Coordinate orchestration across multiple repositories and monorepo package boundaries.

## Roadmap Slot
Q4 2026

## Current State in Repo
Current workflows assume one project root and one repository target per session.

## Target Outcome
Crux can plan and execute across repository/package scopes with isolated worktrees and policies.

## Scope
- Model repository/package targets as first-class scheduling units.
- Support per-target agent assignment, checkout/worktree strategy, and gate

## Target Outcome
Users can discover, install, and verify external role/preset packs.

items.title: Remote Execution Mode
items.description:
## Summary
Run Crux headlessly on remote infrastructure with safe remote monitoring and approval.

## Roadmap Slot
Q4 2026

## Current State in Repo
Current operation assumes local interactive execution; durable remote service mode is not a complete product path yet.

## Target Outcome
Crux can run unattended on a server with secure attach/observe/approve flows.

## Scope
- Introduce daemon/service mode lifecycle and remote-safe logging.
- Add secure remote control surface for status, approvals,

items.title: Crux MCP Server
items.description:
## Summary
Expose Crux operations as MCP tools so external assistants can orchestrate Crux itself.

## Roadmap Slot
Ongoing / Cross-Cutting

## Current State in Repo
Crux exposes CLI commands but does not yet provide an MCP server endpoint for tool-based external control.

## Target Outcome
External MCP clients can call controlled Crux operations (start, status, plan, inspect) through a stable server interface.

## Scope
- Define MCP tool surface and input/output contracts for safe orchestration
